elaine_cs: Quick heads-up — AcmeMap onboarding in 45m. They asked for a "mini-field handbook": 1) one-page, non-technical checklist for PMs, 2) single paste-ready engineer snippet, 3) 3-question Day7 feedback. Goal: avoid renewal churn first week if latency or streaming issues show up.

nina_csm: I'll write PM copy. Keep it plain: actionable steps and clear escalation triggers.

marc_sre: Engineer defaults to include (pasteable): prefix cache, warm-pool for 48h, batch sizing for GPU vs CPU, streaming chunk size. My recommended numbers: conservative TTL=30s batch=8; balanced TTL=150s batch=16; turbo TTL=450s batch=32 (GPU). streaming chunk=128 tokens.

marc_sre: Snippet they can paste:
```json
{"cache":{"enabled":true,"strategy":"prefix","ttl_s":150,"kv_mb":128},"batching":{"adaptive":true,"max_batch_gpu":32,"max_batch_cpu":8,"batch_timeout_ms":20},"streaming":{"chunk_tokens":128,"stream_window_ms":80},"slo":{"p95_ms":250,"fallback_after_ms":300}}
```

marc_sre: Quick triage commands:
```
# cache hit ratio
redwoodctl metrics query --customer acmemap --metric cache_hit_ratio --window 48h
# p95/errors
redwoodctl metrics query --customer acmemap --metric p95_latency,error_rate --window 24h
# tail streaming logs
redwoodctl logs tail --customer acmemap --filter "stream_error" --since 1h
```

jas_support: PM one-pager draft (short):
1) Day0 Smoke: run 5 sample prompts, confirm partial stream tokens and end-to-end success.
2) Day1 Warm: prime top 20 prompt keys (8-12 queries each) to populate KV cache and warm model.
3) Day3 Check: verify p95 latency, error rate, cache hit% (goal >35%).
4) Day7 Renewal Signal: if p95 > 350ms or cache hit < 20% or error spike > 0.5% persist, escalate.

jas_support: Escalation path: CSM -> Support on-call -> SRE pager. Add #cs-acmemap for first 7 days and require Day3 readout.

elaine_cs: Feedback snippet for PMs (Day7) to attach to their team: 1) Are responses acceptable? (yes/no + note); 2) Any responses >500ms? (yes/no + example); 3) Any streaming gaps or truncation? (yes/no).

marc_sre: Fast fixes to include in handbook: switch to conservative profile, reduce max_batch_size by half, lower batch_timeout_ms (20->10), or temporarily disable prefix cache if key churn is suspected. For CPU-only infra use max_batch_cpu=6 and batch_timeout_ms=50.

infra-bot: scheduled job "prefill-top-keys" for acmemap at 2025-06-16T08:00:00Z — status: queued :gear:

nina_csm: Owners: Nina = PM one-pager + email template, Marc = engineer snippet + triage block, Jas = run Day0 and Day3 checks and post results. Elaine = Day7 renewal checkpoint with AE.

elaine_cs: Perfect. I'll upload the one-pager, paste the snippet into the onboarding folder, and send the handoff email. Drop any edge-case notes (chatty UIs, many short tokens, token streaming interleaving) here before EOD. :white_check_mark:
